description: Labelled question pairs for tuning the semantic cache threshold. 'same' means one stored answer would be correct and complete for both questions. 'different' means serving one question's answer to the other would be wrong. 'hard' marks pairs written to trip up embeddings: typos and casual wording that still mean the same thing, and near-identical wording that differs by one number, negation, name, date, direction or format.

categories.negation: differs only by not, un-, without, illegal and so on
categories.name: differs only by one name, place or subject
categories.date: differs only by a day, month or year
categories.order: same words, direction or order swapped
categories.opposite: differs by one opposite word, such as enable and disable
categories.format: same subject, different form of answer asked for
